images.title: Price per mL
images.purpose: Shows four shampoo sizes with their prices and the price of one mL, which is not proportional to volume.
images.composition: Four plain containers in a row, growing in size from left to right, each with two short labels under it. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Left to right: a small flat sachet, a small bottle, a medium bottle and a large bottle, all plain teal (#0072B2) shapes with no text on them. Under each container, first line its size and price, second line its price per mL: sachet '6 mL ₹2' and '₹0.33 per mL'; small bottle '180 mL ₹154' and '₹0.86 per mL'; medium bottle '340 mL ₹276' and '₹0.81 per mL'; large bottle '1000 mL ₹540' and '₹0.54 per mL'. The sachet's per mL label is in a reddish purple (#CC79A7) box as the lowest. Exactly 4 containers.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Compare price per mL; a bigger pack is not always the cheaper way to buy.
images.description: Shows four shampoo sizes with their prices and the price of one mL, which is not proportional to volume.
images.teaching_notes: No brand names on the containers.

image_decisions.why: Unit price is what makes the sizes comparable, and lining them up shows that price does not grow in proportion to volume.
